queue.heading: Order queue
queue.duplicateHint: This transaction ID also appears on another order. Compare both before approving.
queue.confirmApprove: Approve this order and unlock the content?
queue.rejectReasonPlaceholder: Explain what is wrong so the customer can fix it.
queue.rejectReasonRequired: A rejection reason is required — the customer sees it.

login.heading: Admin sign in
login.failed: Sign in failed. Check your credentials.
login.notStaff: This account does not have admin access.

links.heading: Links
links.minOverrideHint: Leave empty to use the global minimum.
links.publishBlocked: A link needs a title and an unlocked body in at least one language before it can go live.

gateways.heading: Payment methods
gateways.nameEnRequired: An English display name is required — the admin panel is English-only.
gateways.referenceHint: bKash Send Money has a Reference field. Showing it is what makes reconciliation reliable.
gateways.fieldLabelEnRequired: An English label is required — the admin panel is English-only.

team.heading: Team
team.ownerHint: Owners can also manage links, methods, team and settings.
team.inviteHint: They must sign up with this exact email first, then you can grant the role.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.subtitle: Store-wide defaults applied to every link.
settings.minAmountHint: Whole taka, exactly as the customer types it. 100 means ৳100.
settings.hideMin: Hide the global minimum from customers
settings.hideMinHint: Customers see only “Pay to unlock” with no price.
settings.recoveryHint: Off until the OTP worker is deployed. Turning it on without the worker leaves customers waiting for a code that never arrives.
settings.maintenanceEnabled: Close the shop to new orders
settings.maintenanceHint: Customers see a closed notice instead of the order form. The database refuses orders as well, so this is a real gate, not only a banner.
settings.maintenanceWarning: The shop is closed. Customers cannot place orders right now.
settings.contactHint: Shown to customers while the shop is closed. Leave blank to remove.

copy.heading: Site copy
copy.subtitle: Reword what customers read. Blank fields fall back to the wording shipped with the app.
copy.fallbackHint: Leave a language blank to keep the shipped wording for it. Clearing both languages removes the override entirely.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.unconfigured: Supabase is not configured. Set the environment variables and reload.
